acceptance_criteria: Traces to its accepted system and software anchors and is verified by its named checks, harness route, or report inspection.
statement: The report shall be bound to the accepted baseline revision and the exact candidate material (inventory, digest, and per-file hashes) and shall record the SHA-256 hashes of the retained evidence, raw samples, and candidate artifacts; the candidate commit is the direct child of the baseline carrying that material.
title: Exact-candidate binding and hashes
